an7.22:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati, gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an7.22:1.3: tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehi putto vajjī abhiyātukāmo hoti.
an7.22:1.5: ahaṃ ime vajjī evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve ucchecchāmi vajjī vināsessāmi vajjī anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmīti.
an7.22:2.1: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehi putto vassakāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ magadhamahāmattaṃ āmantesi:
an7.22:2.2: ehi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vanda, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha:
an7.22:2.3: ”rājā bhante māgadho ajātasattu vedehi putto bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī’ti.
an7.22:2.5: rājā bhante māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātukāmo,
an7.22:2.7: ahaṃ ime vajjī evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve ucchecchāmi vajjī vināsessāmi vajjī anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmi’ti.
an7.22:2.8: yathā bhagavā vyākaroti taṃ sādhukaṃ uggahetvā mama āroceyyāsī,
an7.22:3.1: evaṃ bhoti kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
an7.22:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an7.22:3.3: rājā bho gotama, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhoto gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
an7.22:3.4: rājā bho gotama, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātukāmo.
an7.22:3.6: ahaṃ ime vajjī evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve ucchecchāmi, vajjī vināsessāmi, vajji anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmiti.
an7.22:4.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando bhagavato piṭṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ vījayamāno.
an7.22:4.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi: (1)
an7.22:4.3: kinti te ānanda sutaṃ vajjī abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā sannipāta bahulāti?
an7.22:4.4: sutaṃ me taṃ bhante, vajjī abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā sannipātabahulāti.
an7.22:4.5: yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā bhavissanti, sannipātabahulā, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (2)
an7.22:5.1: kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ, vajjī samaggā sannipatanti samaggā vuṭṭhahanti samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karontīti?
an7.22:5.2: sutaṃ me taṃ bhante, vajjī samaggā sannipatanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahanti samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karontīti.
an7.22:5.3: yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī samaggā sannipatissanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karissanti, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (3)
an7.22:6.1: kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ vajjī apaññattaṃ na paññāpenti, paññattaṃ na samucchindanti. yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattantīti?
an7.22:6.2: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante, vajjī apaññattaṃ na paññāpenti, paññattaṃ na samucchindanti, yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattantīti.
an7.22:6.3: yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī paññattaṃ na paññāpessanti, paññattaṃ na samucchindissanti, yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattissanti, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (4)
an7.22:7.1: kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjī mahallakā, te sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññanti?
an7.22:7.2: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante, vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjimahallakā, te sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññantīti.
an7.22:7.3: yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjī mahallakā te sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañca sotabbaṃ maññissantī, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (5)
an7.22:8.1: kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo tā na okassa pasayha vāsentīti?
an7.22:8.2: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante, vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo tā na okassa pasayha vāsentīti.
an7.22:8.3: yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo tā na okassa pasayha vāsessantī, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (6)
an7.22:9.1: kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca tāni sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjentī, tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpentīti?
an7.22:9.2: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante, vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca tāni sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpentīti.
an7.22:9.3: yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca tāni sakkarissanti, garukarissanti mānessanti, pūjessanti, tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpessanti, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (7)
an7.22:10.1: kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṃvihitā, ‘kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsuṃ vihareyyu’nti.
an7.22:10.2: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇaguttī susaṃvihitā bhavissati ‘kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsuṃ vihareyyu’nti.
an7.22:10.3: yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṃvihitā bhavissati ‘kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsuṃ vihareyyunti’ vuddhiyeva ānanda vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti.
an7.22:11.1: atha kho bhagavā vassakāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ magadhamahāmattaṃ āmantesi.
an7.22:11.2: ekamidāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, samayaṃ vesāliyaṃ viharāmi sārandade cetiye.
an7.22:11.3: tatrāhaṃ brāhmaṇa vajjīnaṃ ime satta aparihānīye dhamme desesiṃ.
an7.22:11.4: yāvakīvañca brāhmaṇa, ime satta aparihānīyā dhammā vajjīsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu vajjī sandissanti, vuddhiyeva brāhmaṇa, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti. evaṃ vutte vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an7.22:12.1: ekamekenapi bho gotama, aparihānīyena dhammena samannāgatānaṃ vajjīnaṃ vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni,
an7.22:12.2: ko pana vādo sattahi aparihānīyehi dhammehi?
an7.22:12.3: akaraṇīyā ca bho gotama, vajjī raññā māgadhena ajātasattunā vedehi puttena yadidaṃ yuddhassa aññatra upalāpanā aññatra mithubhedā.
an7.22:12.4: handacadāni mayaṃ bho gotama, gacchāma, bahukiccā mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyāti.
an7.22:12.6: atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.
